metadata.description: AI model retirement notifier: Consumption Logic App (system-assigned identity, weekly recurrence) and a new Office 365 Outlook API connection. Workflow parameters are editable definition defaults; update them in the Logic App designer after deployment.
Name of the Logic App (Consumption) to create.
Name of the new Office 365 Outlook API connection. Authorize it after deployment.
Region for the Logic App and the connection. Defaults to the resource group region.
Keep Disabled until the connection is authorized and the workflow parameters are updated. Enabling may start the first run immediately.
Grant the Logic App managed identity Reader on this subscription so it can list AI deployments and model catalogs. Requires Owner or User Access Administrator. Set false to grant access manually.

Digest_preview.inputs:
@concat('

Weekly AI model retirement assessment

', outputs('Scan_summary')['status'], '

UTC scan date: ', outputs('Scan_date_UTC'), '.

A model requires attention if either of exactly two conditions is true (OR): (1) Model retirement date is from today through ', outputs('Retirement_horizon'), ' (today plus ', string(parameters('retirementHorizonMonths')), ' calendar months, both boundaries inclusive); OR (2) Model retirement date is strictly earlier than today.

Collected: ', string(length(variables('deployments'))), '; assessed rows: ', string(length(variables('rows'))), '; no condition matched: ', string(length(body('No_match_models'))), '; attention required: ', string(length(body('Old_models'))), '; unassessed retirement dates: ', string(length(body('Unknown_models'))), '; errors: ', string(length(variables('errors'))), '.

Models requiring attention - matched retirement condition

', body('Attention_models_table'), '

Unassessed models - unknown retirement date

', body('Unknown_models_table'), '

Inventory / assessment errors

', body('Inventory_errors_table'), '

Model retirement date comes only from deprecation.inference on the exact account/format/model/version catalog record. Version is an opaque identity string. Missing, invalid, conflicting or incomplete catalog metadata is Unknown / Unassessed and never triggers email by itself; no other date is substituted. Dates are compared as UTC calendar days, using calendar months rather than a fixed number of days. Email is sent only when a retirement condition matches and notifications are enabled.

')

Digest_subject.inputs: @concat(if(greater(length(variables('errors')), 0), '[PARTIAL SCAN / ERRORS] ', if(greater(length(body('Old_models')), 0), '[MODEL ATTENTION] ', '[MODEL SCAN] ')), 'Weekly AI model retirement assessment - ', outputs('Scan_date_UTC'))

postDeploymentSteps.value: 1) Open the Office 365 connection > Edit API connection > Authorize > Save. 2) In the Logic App designer, update the workflow parameters (subscriptionId, recipientEmail, retirementHorizonMonths, sendNotifications) and publish. 3) Grant the Logic App identity Reader on any other scanned subscriptions. 4) Enable the Logic App; the first run may start immediately.
